title: Refactoring analysis of the post-maintenance-refactor surface (c5caf02..HEAD)
deliberation_reason: Phase 0 nomination was a single-answer decision — only one defensible cluster (boot/restore orchestration) was nominated. Under OSD rule, a genuinely single-answer track records 'not carried as a candidate' with its reason rather than padding a straw rival. Decision point for a real deliberation: future Phase 0 nomination if more than one defensible cluster is nominated.

#1.text: **AC-1**: `js/boot.js` exposes exactly ONE top-level binding (`window.Boot = { boot }`), is idempotent across re-injection, is loaded AFTER its seams and BEFORE its one caller (`js/main.js`), and every step `boot()` drives resolves through `window` at call time — a missing seam is SKIPPED, not fatal, and a throwing seam cannot abort the boot. Falsified if: a second top-level binding appears, re-injection throws or double-runs, the injected order regresses, or an absent/throwing seam aborts the sequence.

#2.text: **AC-2**: `js/main.js` delegates to `await window.Boot.boot()` instead of keeping a second copy of the sequence, and keeps only the activation-overlay mount + the re-run gate. Falsified if: main.js retains a duplicate of the boot sequence, or loses the mount/gate responsibilities.
